types.name: Bleeding
types.desc: Each application deals 1 damage per second for 5 seconds. Applications stack independently.

types.name: Poison
types.desc: A damage-over-time totalling 120% of the triggering damage over 3 seconds.

types.name: Toxic
types.desc: A damage-over-time totalling 180% of the triggering damage over 9 seconds.

types.name: Burning
types.desc: Each application deals 1 damage and strips 1 armor per second for 3 seconds; both effects land in a radius around the victim.

types.name: Electric
types.desc: Deals its damage in a small area around the target.

frost.desc: -30% attack speed and move speed for 3 seconds.

frozen.desc: Cannot move for 3 seconds and takes +30% damage.
